documents.content:
Dear Customer Support Team,

I am writing to formally raise a complaint regarding my Samsung Galaxy S26
Ultra (Model: SM-S938B), which I purchased on 15th November 2024.

My Customer ID is CUST10001.

Issue Description:
Since the last week of March 2026, my device has been experiencing
persistent WiFi connectivity drops. The phone disconnects from the network
every few hours and requires a manual reconnect. I have already tried the
following troubleshooting steps without success:

- Restarted the router and the device
- Forgotten and re-added the WiFi network
- Reset network settings on the device

The issue continues to occur and is significantly affecting my day-to-day
work as a Software Engineer, as I rely on stable internet connectivity.

Desired Resolution:
I would like the device to be repaired under warranty, as it is clearly a
hardware or firmware defect and the product is well within its 12-month
warranty period.

I have attached a copy of my purchase invoice for your reference.

Please acknowledge this complaint and advise on the next steps at your
earliest convenience.

Thank you,
Shubham Sahu
Customer ID: CUST10001
Phone: +91-98765-43210
Email: shubhh2003@gmail.com
City: Dehradun, Uttarakhand

Dear Shubham Sahu,

Thank you for contacting Consumer Electronics Customer Support regarding your
Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra (Complaint Reference: CMP-ING-1775104634518-f5fc7ef).

We have carefully reviewed your complaint. Unfortunately, we are unable to process
this complaint under our warranty or guarantee scheme for the following reason:

  Reason: The product is outside its manufacturer's warranty period.

Our records (or the documents provided) indicate that your product was purchased on 2024-11-15, and the manufacturer's warranty expired on 2025-11-15.

Options available to you:
  1. Out-of-warranty repair service — we can provide a paid repair quote.
     Please contact our service centre at: repairs@electronics.com
  2. Extended warranty — if you purchased an extended warranty, please provide
     your extended warranty certificate number.
  3. Consumer rights — depending on your jurisdiction, statutory consumer rights
     may still apply. Please contact your local consumer authority for guidance.

If you believe this decision has been made in error, or if you have additional
evidence (e.g. a different purchase date or extended warranty), please reply to
this email within 14 days and we will be happy to re-evaluate your case.

We apologise for any inconvenience caused.

Kind regards,
Customer Support Team
Consumer Electronics
